releaseNotes.title: Release notes and supporting G-Browser
releaseNotes.description: Advertising revenue supports G-Browser development and operation. Choose how to open release notes after updates. You can change this later in Settings → Updates & Experiments.

disabled.label: Do not open automatically
disabled.description: Do not open release notes after updates. Keep your blocker settings when visiting the blog.

blocking.label: Open with your blocker settings
blocking.description: Keep your extensions working as configured. This does not install or enable an ad blocker.

support.label: Allow ads to support G-Browser (recommended)
support.description: Restrict uBlock Origin, AdGuard, Adblock Plus, AdBlock and Ghostery on the G-Browser blog.

releaseNotes.scope: The restriction applies to all HTTPS pages on blog.gbrowser.app, including manually opened pages, and affects tracking protection and custom filters as well as ad blocking. Other extensions are not restricted by this setting. Ads may still be blocked by other protection tools. Reload open blog pages after changing the setting.
releaseNotes.applyOnConfirm: Your selection takes effect only when you confirm. Closing this page keeps your current setting.
releaseNotes.applyOnFinish: This is a draft selection. It takes effect when you finish setup on the next screen. Closing setup before then keeps your current setting.

hubPage.title: About G-Browser Hub
hubPage.subtitle: A central place for G-Browser-specific settings.
hubPage.description: G-Browser Hub is a dedicated settings center for G-Browser-specific options. You can open it by navigating to 'about:hub'. It can also be accessed from the left sidebar of Firefox's settings page at 'about:preferences'.
hubPage.tip: Tip: You can also access G-Browser Hub from the Firefox settings sidebar.

features.accessible: Accessible from about:hub or Firefox settings
features.centralized: All G-Browser-specific options in one place

customize.title: Tilpas G-Browser
customize.description: Tilpas til dine foretrukne indstillinger. Du kan altid ændre dem senere fra G-Browser Hub eller indstillingssiden.

appearance.title: Indstillinger for udseende
appearance.description: Du kan tilpasse G-Browser's udseende til dine præferencer. Vælg et lys eller mørkt tema, eller skift det automatisk baseret på dine systemindstillinger.

floorpHub.title: G-Browser Hub
floorpHub.description: G-Browser Hub is a dedicated settings center for G-Browser-specific options. You can open it by navigating to 'about:hub'. It can also be accessed from the left sidebar of Firefox's settings page at 'about:preferences'.

welcomePage.description: G-Browser er en hurtig og brugervenlig webbrowser med fokus på privatliv og sikkerhed. Denne guide introducerer dig til de vigtigste funktioner og indstillinger i G-Browser.
welcomePage.readyToStart: Når du er klar, så klik på knappen nedenfor for at fortsætte.

localizationPage.title: G-Browser taler dit sprog
localizationPage.subtitle: Tjek sprogindstillinger og skift om nødvendigt
localizationPage.chooseLanguage: Vælg mellem en bred vifte af sprog

featuresPage.title: Primære G-Browser-funktioner

panelSidebar.title: Sidepanel
panelSidebar.description: Få adgang til praktiske funktioner fra sidepanelet til højre, mens du browser. Du kan placere webpaneler, notefunktioner, tilføjelser, bogmærker m.m. i sidepanelet.
features: Tag hurtigt noter med G-Browser Noter, mens du browser

workspaces.title: Arbejdsområder
workspaces.description: Organize multiple tab sets to streamline your work. Quickly switch between workspaces with distinctive icons and names. Access via the workspace button in the top left.
features: Kategoriser efter formål: arbejde, privat osv.

pwa.title: Understøttelse af progressive webapplikationer
pwa.description: On Windows, you can add PWA-compatible sites as desktop applications when you visit them. Regular websites can also be installed.

mouseGesture.title: Musebevægelser
mouseGesture.description: Styr din browser mere intuitivt med indbygget understøttelse af musebevægelser. Udfør bevægelser ved at holde højre museknap nede og bevæge musen.
features: Naviger hurtigt mellem sider og historik

finishPage.title: Opsætning fuldført!
finishPage.subtitle: Tillykke! Du har gennemført G-Browser-opsætningen. Du kan nu nyde behagelig og sikker internetbrowsing.
finishPage.hint: Du kan tilpasse mere detaljerede indstillinger via "Indstillinger" i menuknappen øverst til højre.
finishPage.defaultBrowserSuccess: G-Browser er blevet indstillet som din standardbrowser!
